nodes.title: ## Why Choose ZX Bank Bike Loan?
nodes.summary: Lists the benefits of the bike loan: interest rates starting from 9.49% p.a., loan amount up to 100% of the on-road bike price, repayment tenure of 12 to 48 months, sanction in as little as 24 hours via a paperless process, and transparent processing with no hidden charges.

nodes.title: ## Key Features
nodes.summary: Highlights key features including funding of up to Rs 2 lakhs for two-wheelers (including electric bikes), a 10-minute e-KYC and instant eligibility check, zero prepayment charges after 12 EMIs, and a special interest rate for women applicants and rural borrowers.

nodes.title: ## How to Apply for a Bike Loan
nodes.summary: Explains the two ways to apply for a bike loan: online through the ZX Bank Asia app or website, or in person at a ZX Bank branch with staff assistance.

children.title: 1. **Online via ZX Bank Asia App or Website**
children.summary: Steps for the online route: download the ZX Bank Asia app or visit the website, select Apply for Bike Loan under the Loans section, fill in details and upload documents (eKYC, income proof, bike quotation), then get instant approval and track status in-app.

children.title: 2. **At Your Nearest ZX Bank Branch**
children.summary: At a branch, applicants visit any ZX Bank branch with basic KYC documents and the bike quotation, complete the application form with staff assistance, and receive approval and documentation support.

nodes.title: ## Eligibility
nodes.summary: Eligibility criteria for the bike loan: age between 21 and 60 years, applicants must be salaried, self-employed, or business owners, minimum monthly income of ₹8,000 (varies by region), and a CIBIL score above 650 preferred.

nodes.title: ## Required Documents
nodes.summary: Documents required for the bike loan: identity proof (Aadhaar/Passport/PAN), address proof, a recent photograph, income proof (salary slip/ITR/bank statement), and the bike quotation or invoice.

nodes.title: ## Need Help?
nodes.summary: Help channels for bike loan customers: chat with Zia AI assistant in the mobile app, email customercare@zxbank.asia, or call the toll-free helpline 1800-123-ZXZX.
